# Controller-stage fake95 instrument review — 2026-09-14

No blocking instrument or copy defect found. The frozen proposal and the two prepared copies are suitable for root's separate fake-service admission. This is a source-only conclusion; none of the 95 cases was executed by this reviewer.

The proposal PINS is `b831bf6c864d8a7bef24355e5868dfa7480e6bba6ff1381cbc3ac9db07388606`. Independent passive check 79a326/0 verifies all 29 parent inputs (481,412 bytes), 25 child text bindings, 23 ordered modules, all 31 source/before copy-plan pairs, and complete forward/reverse reconstruction of the five qualifier and six launcher diff hunks. Reconstruction compares complete text with CRLF normalized to LF; the separate file checks bind exact bytes.

The qualifier is `6eafdbd476026a3b01750d6abfb6c4d429078eea766410fc9a2803f7f9c3c846`; the proposal/author launcher is `b71b436882df599c0650220383ed338f745345e19ca4217c9be1fe18eacf8930`. The original 81 ordered IDs remain the exact prefix, followed by the 14 frozen stage IDs. All three old test files and the startup fixture remain byte-identical. The isolated adapter is the reviewed stage derivative; its accepted 28,922-byte prefix is exact. The canonical adapter/resolver and the loaded durable, native-interface, protocol and generated sources retain the startup81 pins.

The full baseline guard/launcher reads and complete current deltas preserve the closed read/import boundary, preloads, 12 metadata traps, baseline-winreg traps, capture limits, ten result guards, explicit case loading and final real-entry refusals. The temporary resolver alias still restores in `finally` before test definitions. Qualifier lines 155–164 capture the exact shared `_DurableKernel` class and append only the two stage functions; lines 228–231 verify all 38 functions and both class bindings at completion. Separate check b8bb17/0 verifies the original 36 function names remain the exact prefix. The two appended modules require only already loaded modules/stdlib.

The launcher retains fixed flat input copies, original/copied before/after bindings, admission/PINS/launcher checks, native-exit capture, ordered case/guard/output validation and separate qualification/outer statuses. Its count changes are 27→29 inputs and 81→95 cases. Existing limits remain: this guard does not impose a hard execution deadline, and pre-invocation failures need the actual outer tool result.

Copy check b8bb17/0 independently verifies:
- `controller-stage-fake95-author01`: all 29 payloads and PINS exact to the proposal.
- `controller-stage-fake95-confirmation01`: all 25 child texts and 28 parent payloads exact; only five launcher label literals change to `controller-stage-confirmation01`. PINS is `6fdc1188f323541aaff93a3fb5205f54e395b13d5b20ebf8a95bd69420e864cb`; launcher is `acf6025208f28439da704cd70ec682471c7344012af6f61fa639ccc3583a9b8f`.
- Both directories held exactly 31 preparation files, false templates and no actual admission/run at that observation.

The two reviewer preparation mistakes are preserved in PREPARATION-CORRECTIONS.md and their actual objects. They were not subject failures. This review does not independently approve the 14 case bodies authored by this reviewer; the separate source peer verdict is `5411dcf6497de2323aee124b642855f49500315cd1e529189292fbac4705e128`. No Windows, pipe/read-set authentication, real model, backend or inference qualification is claimed.
